input: Lobby my HOA to add a community garden plot

gold.taskTitle: Lobby HOA to Approve a Community Garden Plot
gold.taskDescription: Persuade the HOA to approve and establish a community garden plot within the neighborhood.

questions.title: Which HOA meeting is your target deadline?
questions.description: Identify the specific upcoming HOA meeting or vote the user wants to present at or influence.

questions.title: Do you have a specific location in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has already identified a physical spot within the community for the garden.

questions.title: Have you spoken to any neighbors about this?
questions.description: Gauge how much existing neighbor support or interest the user has already built.

questions.title: What is your HOA's formal proposal submission process?
questions.description: Understand whether there is a written proposal, petition, or agenda request required by the HOA.

questions.title: What is the main concern your HOA board might raise?
questions.description: Identify anticipated objections such as maintenance, liability, cost, or aesthetics.

questions.title: Who would manage and maintain the garden ongoing?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user plans to lead upkeep personally, form a committee, or propose another structure.

questions.title: Is there a budget or funding source you have in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user expects HOA funding, resident contributions, grants, or self-funding for setup costs.
